The median (average) price of a single‑family home in California is roughly **$800 000–$850 000** (USD).  
This figure is based on the most recent U.S. Census and real‑estate data (e.g., Zillow, Redfin, and the U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey).  

> *Median home price in California (2024)*: ≈ $825 000  
> *Median home price in Los Angeles County*: ≈ $1 200 000  
> *Median home price in San Francisco Bay Area*: ≈ $1 500 000  

These numbers reflect the median sale price; the actual average can vary slightly depending on the data source and whether you include all property types (condos, townhomes, etc.). For the most up‑to‑date figures, check local MLS listings or state housing reports.
